svg.title: A Behrend digit sphere
svg.desc: Computed: the vectors of {0,1,2}^3 with squared norm 5 are the six permutations of (0,1,2); they lie on the circle where the sphere meets the plane x+y+z = 3. Their base-24 encodings avoid every relation j(s2-s1) = i(s3-s1) with 1 <= |i|,|j| <= 2, i != j: 1,440 checks.
